caseName: Pacific Western Oil Corp. ex rel. George F. Getty, Inc. v. Franchise Tax Board
caseNameFull: Pacific Western Oil Corp., successor in interest to George F. Getty, Inc. v. Franchise Tax Board of California
attorneys: Joseph D. Peeler, John P. Pollock, David W. Richmond and Robert N. Miller for appellant. Edmund G. Brown, Attorney General of California, James E. Sabine, Irving II. Perluss, Assistant Attorneys General, and Ernest P. Goodman, Deputy Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
